name: punchline-ferry
title: Guffaw Galleon
description: A collaborative joke construction game where players board the Comedy Ferry and work together to craft the perfect joke across three stages.
instructions: Submit funny words to the Token Bank. Fill in joke setups, incorporate forced words, and deliver punchlines. Vote for the funniest jokes!

amen.title: The Ark of Laughs
amen.description: Build jokes together — one person starts, another finishes. What sails out of this ark may surprise you!
